description:
Use this when a measurement needs converting between units (kWh to MJ, bbl to m3). Resolve unsure codes with ofp_units first.

Answers {value, unit, provenance}; keep provenance. A 422 refusal is data: error (unresolved_unit, incompatible_dimension, assumption_required, invalid_conversion_parameters) + detail; read it, do not blind-retry. Volume to energy/mass needs a declared assumption (calorificValue or density); the detail names required fields — never invent. dictionary ([name@]version) is a pin; mismatches refuse. Not CO2e.
name: ofp_convert
title: Open Footprint: convert units
